script:
exact match xs with
  | [] => ⟨[], by simp⟩
  | x :: t =>
    if h : x ∈ t then
      ⟨(dedup t).val, (dedup t).property.1, fun y => by
        rw [(dedup t).property.2]
        constructor
        · intro hy; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy
        · intro hy
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
          · exact h
          · exact hy⟩
    else
      ⟨x :: (dedup t).val, List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨by rw [(dedup t).property.2]; exact h, (dedup t).property.1⟩, fun y => by
        rw [List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons, (dedup t).property.2]⟩
spec_check: Spec is satisfiable (order-preserving dedup) and not vacuous.
goal:
xs : List Nat
⊢ { ys // ys.Nodup ∧ ∀ (x : Nat), x ∈ ys ↔ x ∈ xs }
